question: Should OpenClaw expose `models.providers.openai.params.codexProxyBaseUrl` as a supported credential-routing contract for trusted local brokers, with the proposed strict loopback-only boundary?
rationale: This is a new configuration and credential trust boundary, not a mechanical bug fix; maintainers must decide whether the broker contract belongs in the bundled OpenAI provider and what support/compatibility commitment it carries.

options.title: Approve the loopback contract
options.body: Accept the narrowly validated local proxy setting once the exact Codex protocol and live broker proof are reviewed.

options.title: Keep this deployment-specific
options.body: Decline the bundled configuration surface and direct the broker integration to an external plugin or deployment-owned wrapper.

recommendation.title: Approve the loopback contract
recommendation.body: Accept the narrowly validated local proxy setting once the exact Codex protocol and live broker proof are reviewed.

likelyOwner.reason: The available PR and issue context identifies osolmaz as the repository-member contributor currently carrying the proposed OpenAI proxy boundary; broader ownership provenance could not be read locally.
